title: Brightening peel consultation candidate
summary: A brightening peel is the strongest dark-spot option, usually has two to four days of visible flaking, and requires an in-person sensitivity assessment before treatment.

title: Brightening facial consultation candidate
summary: A brightening facial is the gentlest dark-spot option with little to no downtime, but results are more gradual and usually require a series.

title: LED and barrier-support consultation candidate
summary: LED and barrier-support care may suit easily irritated skin and has no downtime, but it supports skin recovery rather than directly treating deeper pigmentation.

title: Home-care routine consultation candidate
summary: A gradual home-care plan may include gentle brightening products and daily sunscreen after product review. It has minimal downtime but requires consistent use over several weeks.

title: Beauty Clinic in-person skin consultation
summary: During the in-person consultation, an aesthetician reviews skin history and current products, examines sensitivity and pigmentation, confirms a suitable treatment plan, and performs treatment only after the client agrees.
